about: I am a final-year undergraduate in Software Engineering at Hangzhou City University and a Visiting Scholar at Duke-NUS Medical School, Singapore, working with [Prof. Nan Liu](https://www.duke-nus.edu.sg/directory/detail/liu-nan).
I am also interested in computer-use agents and LLM evaluation frameworks, and am part of the startup [Touchstone AI](https://touchstoneai.org/).

interests.introduction: My research interests lie in medical artificial intelligence, computer-use agents, and high-performance computing. I work on building data, evaluation frameworks, and efficient systems for AI.
themes: **Medical AI.** Clinical dialogue simulation, synthetic healthcare data, and multimodal diagnostic reasoning evaluation.
**Agents and efficient systems.** Cross-platform computer-use benchmarks, GPU inference optimization, and high-performance computing.

about: 我叫鲍竹涵，目前是浙大城市学院软件工程专业本科生，并在新加坡杜克-国大医学院（Duke-NUS）担任访问学者，师从 [Nan Liu 教授](https://www.duke-nus.edu.sg/directory/detail/liu-nan)。
我同时对计算机使用代理和大模型评测框架感兴趣，也是初创企业 [Touchstone AI](https://touchstoneai.org/) 的一员。

interests.introduction: 我的研究兴趣包括医疗人工智能、计算机使用代理和高性能计算，主要围绕 AI 数据、评测框架与高效系统开展工作。
themes: **医疗人工智能。** 临床对话模拟、合成医疗数据，以及多模态诊断推理评测。
**智能体与高效系统。** 跨平台计算机使用基准、GPU 推理优化与高性能计算。
